result.topic_en: Calculations of the values of log k' and log(2K/π) at rational points x = mπ/(2n), mπ/n via Lambert-type series, finite geometric sums over roots of unity and Gauss/Legendre-symbol sums, giving closed forms in terms of q and q_0.
result.transcription:
$-\log k' = 8\sum \frac{1}{t}\frac{q^t}{1-q^{2t}} = 4i\sum\frac{1}{t+it x}$ , $q = e^{xi}$

1.) $x = \frac{m}{2n}\pi$, $m$ ungerade[?].
$-\log k' = 4i\sum_{0,\infty}^{t}\sum_{1,4n-1}^{s}\frac{1}{4nt+s}\,\frac{1}{\sin\frac{sm\pi}{2n}}$
$= 8\int_0^1 \sum^{s}\frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{4n}}\,\frac{\alpha^{sm}}{1-\alpha^{2ms}}$
$= 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,4n}^{t}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{-1}{2n}\sum_{1,4n-1}^{s}\sum_{0,2n-1}^{\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{ms(2\sigma+1)}\alpha^{-ts}$
[-da-] $\frac{1}{1-r\alpha^{2ms}} = \sum_{0,2n-1}^{\sigma}\frac{r^\sigma\alpha^{2ms\sigma}}{1-r^{2n}}$
$\frac{1}{1-\alpha^{2ms}} = \frac{-1}{2n}\sum_{0,2n-1}^{\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{2ms\sigma}$
$t\equiv m(2r+1) \mod 4n$

$= 8\sum_{0,2n-1}^{r}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\cdots$
$= \pi i\left((m-2)n - 4\sum_{0,n-1}^{s}\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{m(2s+1)}{4n}\right)\right)$

2) $x = \frac{m\pi}{n}$, $n$ ungerade.
$-\log k' = -\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0}\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\,q_0^{-n} + 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{2n}}\,\frac{\alpha^{ms}}{1-\alpha^{2ms}}$
$= A + 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n}^{t}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\cdot\frac{-1}{2n}\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\sum_{0,n-1}^{\sigma}\left(\frac{\sigma-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)\alpha^{ms(2\sigma+1)}\alpha^{-ts}$
1) $t\equiv m(2r+1) \mod 2n$
2) $t\equiv m(2r+1)+n$
$= A + 8\sum_{0,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})\frac{1}{2n}\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)n - 8\sum\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)+n})\frac{1}{2n}\cdot n\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)$
$= A + 8\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+mn}) - \log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+mn})\right)$
$= A + 4\pi i\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)(\ldots) - 4\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+(m+1)n}) - \log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+(m+1)n})\right)$
$= A + 8\pi i\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\frac{2ms+(m+1)n}{2n}\right) - \left(\frac{2ms+mn}{2n}\right)$
$= A + 4\pi i\sum\frac{\mu s}{n}\left(\left(\frac{2s+(m+1)n}{2n}\right) - \left(\frac{2s+mn}{2n}\right)\right)$, $m\mu\equiv 1 \mod n$
$= A + 4\pi i(-1)^{m+1}\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}\right)$
$= (-1)^{m+1}\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0} + \pi i\left(\frac{n-1}{n}\mu - 4\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)\right)$

$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = 4\sum\frac{q^t}{t\cdot(1+q^t)} = \log\left(\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}\right) + 4\sum\frac{1}{t}\left(\frac{q^t}{1+q^t} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{q^t}{q_0^t}\right)$
$= \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2i\sum\frac{1}{t}\,\mathrm{tg}\,t\frac{x}{2}$,

1) $x = \frac{2m\pi}{n}$, $n$ ungerade.
$\alpha = [-\pi-] e^{\frac{\pi i}{2n}}$ $\frac{1}{1+r\alpha^{2sm}} = \sum_{0,n-1}\frac{(-1)^\sigma r^\sigma\alpha^{2s\sigma m}}{1+r^n}$
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\sum\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\frac{1}{2nt+s}\,\frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1}$
$= \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n}^{t}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\alpha^{-ts}\sum_{1,n-1}^{\sigma}(-1)^\sigma\alpha^{2s\sigma m}$
$= \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\sum_{1,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm})(-1)^r\frac{1}{2n}(n-2\ldots) - 2\sum\log(1-\alpha^{2rm+n})(-1)^r\frac{1}{2n}\cdot n$

methods.what: Lambert-series / partial-fraction expansion of -log k' in terms of q = e^{xi}
Finite geometric-sum expansion over roots of unity used to resolve denominators
Value of -log k' at x = mπ/(2n) via sums of the floor function
Value of -log k' at x = mπ/n (n odd) expressed with Legendre symbols and floor sums, with mμ ≡ 1 mod n
Series for log(2K/π) separated into a singular log term plus a tangent series
Integral/log-sum evaluation of log(2K/π) at x = 2mπ/n via roots of unity
